text.title: RAG Policy Thresholds Decision Tree
text.summary: Tree that first checks the policy is computable (numeric thresholds, ordered bands, queryable inputs, fresh review), then maps the worst signal to a colour and its bound action.

decision-tree.root-question: Is every signal numeric, does red lie strictly beyond amber, and does `input_source` name a repeatable query?

conclusion.verdict: repair: replace the prose with a number and comparator, or delete the signal

branch.when: red_threshold not strictly beyond amber_threshold in the comparator direction

conclusion.verdict: repair: reorder the thresholds; check lt-signals copied from gt rows

branch.when: input_source is an estimate or opinion rather than a named query

conclusion.verdict: repair: point the signal at a JQL / Sentry / finance query; exclude it from compute until then
repair: add an incident, post-mortem or policy anchor per signal before publishing
refresh: run the quarterly review first; do NOT compute colours from a stale policy

branch.when: policy computable AND fresh AND worst signal beyond red_threshold

conclusion.verdict: colour=Red: fire actions.red at compute time; sponsor notified within the stated bound

branch.when: policy computable AND fresh AND worst signal beyond amber_threshold only

conclusion.verdict: colour=Amber: run actions.amber before the cycle ends; cite policy version in the report

branch.when: policy computable AND fresh AND no signal beyond amber_threshold

conclusion.verdict: colour=Green: continue normal cadence; record value, version and last_reviewed

branch.when: PM wants to report a colour other than the computed one

conclusion.verdict: allowed only with a review_log override entry; a computed Red can never be reported lower

branch.when: fewer than 3 reports per year OR no recurring cadence OR regulated framework mandates its own status scheme

conclusion.verdict: preconditions not met; adopt the mandated framework or skip

text.example: all thresholds numeric, red beyond amber, last_reviewed 40 days ago → schedule_variance_pct=22 gt red_threshold=20 → Red; sponsor notified within 4h, rescue playbook opened.
